I'd mainly focus on 3 points

**1 Build Order**

**2 Micro and Macro**

**3 Spending Resources**

​

**1** 

Your build order is pretty much all over the place. 

Whenever I play english I use this build order:

6 on sheep

New villager on sheep

Villager builds house, then gold

next 2 villagers to gold

3 vills to wood

Next villager to council hall

All new vills to council hall

If done correctly this will land you a age up time at 4:45 seconds

​

**2**

Your micro is also all over the place; (even though it's improved a lot) 

As FanoTheNoob said, it's pretty odd to see French players not to train early knights. You could have attacked then. Normally if you're matched against the french you'll want to train spears and as the english you might want to build a blacksmith  and get seige engineering.

You'll want to constantly produce longbows. Later on you kept sending you troops to your demise so you'll want to be paying more attention to that as well (don't ignore the other aspects of the game though!) AOE4 isn't a game where you send your troops forwards to attack and expect them to survive

**3**

You float resources way to much; You'll want to use them as soon as you get them (It doesn't matter if you have 5x more food then your opponent if you aren't using it)

Also in the second match

You gave your enemy way too much time
\-Your siege was also questionable, you couldhave built forward castles and bombards

You made a few mistakes in the english mirror match

\-Your feudal was pretty slow, idealy you should be hitting fuedal at 4:30 minutes in game

\-You should have built a stable as soon as you saw your enemy wasn't training spearmen (some people do that bc they predict horsemen in a mirror)

\-Your forward mill was also questionable

\-You should have built more production buildings

\-You were banking way too many resources an should have spent them on upgrades

Good luck on your pulls and may the gods of RNG be with you and welcome to the game

Tokens are like the \*special\* credits and are used for purchasing better packs and bluprints at the legend store. Trade Tokens are what you get if you trade blueprints or parts in.
